meta.title: A synthetic AI inference workflow
meta.subtitle: Hypothetical systems research talk · not empirical results
meta.goal: Review a traceable illustrative workflow and define evidence needed for a real study

slides.title: A traceable AI inference workflow
slides.speaker_notes: State clearly that every system and number in this talk is synthetic and hypothetical.

slides.title: Inference systems coordinate requests across shared resources
slides.assertion_title: The teaching scenario needs a clear request-to-worker path
body: This is a framing scenario for the generator example, not an empirical claim about deployed systems.
slides.speaker_notes: Explain that the scenario was written to exercise slide structures. Do not generalize it to real inference deployments.

slides.title: What would a real evaluation need to establish?
body: Define the workload, request mix and measurement protocol
Compare policies under the same hardware and traffic
Report repeated independent runs and uncertainty
Retain source logs, exclusions, units and code versions
slides.speaker_notes: These are proposed evaluation requirements, not results from this fixture.

slides.title: Separate request handling, control, and execution
slides.speaker_notes: Every box and connector is a native PowerPoint shape or connector. The architecture is hypothetical; do not present it as a product deployment.

slides.title: A request passes through explicit routing stages
body: Conceptual sequence from the hypothetical architecture description.
slides.speaker_notes: Describe the flow as a design sketch, not a measured implementation.

slides.title: Keep illustrative inputs linked to their original files
slides.assertion_title: Each local image retains a source record and file hash
body: The two original SVG illustrations are embedded as image objects.
Their paths are not converted into editable PowerPoint vector primitives.
slides.speaker_notes: The SVG source is local and attributed in the asset manifest as an original CC0-1.0 demonstration. The verified flag remains false pending human confirmation.

slides.title: Three hypothetical values map directly from the CSV
slides.assertion_title: The chart copies one synthetic latency row per condition
body: Synthetic fixture only; no benchmark or system conclusion.
slides.figure_description: Native bar chart of three fictional per-condition latency values copied directly from the bundled CSV.
slides.speaker_notes: The chart values are copied from the labeled synthetic CSV. One row per condition is not repeated-run evidence; no uncertainty or causal interpretation is supported.

slides.title: The fixture cannot support a performance conclusion
slides.assertion_title: Synthetic single-row values do not estimate real system behavior
body: No real system, workload, hardware or experiment was measured.
No repeated runs, error bars, significance test or causal analysis exists.
slides.speaker_notes: Keep this limitation visible whenever the example is reused.

slides.title: Collect the evidence needed for a defensible comparison
body: Freeze a workload and a predeclared metric
Capture independent run IDs and source-row locators
Record hardware, software versions and system configuration
Validate data and inspect every rendered slide with a human reviewer
slides.speaker_notes: These are proposed next steps, not completed experiments.

slides.title: Which measurement should the real study prioritize?
body: Choose the workload and primary metric before collecting results.
All diagrams and values in this example remain hypothetical.
slides.speaker_notes: Ask the audience to choose a workload and primary measurement for a future real evaluation.
